description: Zcash network and node state: mempool size and bytes, node version, difficulty, network hashrate, chain progress and disk, block subsidy, and the funding streams (including Zcash Community Grants). When to use: macro questions about Zcash - how much hashrate secures it, whether our node is caught up, what the block subsidy and funding allocations currently are. Do not use: for shielded-pool supplies (zec_get_pool_status) or our node's own sync state (zec_get_pool_status / chain_status). Returns: mempool, network, difficulty, network_hashrate_hs, blockchain, height, verification_progress, size_on_disk_gb, block_reward_zec, funding_streams[], lockbox_streams[].
name: zec_get_network_stats
